name: BRMData
summary: 面向家庭任务的双臂移动机器人操作数据集，覆盖单臂与双臂、桌面与移动操作、人机互动以及刚性和柔性物体，并提供多视角和深度观测。
summaryEn: A bimanual-mobile robot manipulation dataset for household tasks spanning single- and dual-arm, tabletop and mobile, human-interactive, rigid, and flexible-object scenarios.
